$comment: The performance budget, in GZIPPED BYTES of JavaScript per route (#60).
Enforced by `npm run perf`, which CI runs. See scripts/perf-budget.mjs for what is measured.
WHY THESE NUMBERS. Each is the measured cost on 2026-08-03 plus about 5% headroom —
enough that a minifier or Vite update does not turn CI red, tight enough that a new
dependency or a second island on a route does not slip in unnoticed. A new island is
roughly 1-3 KB gzipped; a new dependency is usually ten times that. The budget is set to
catch the second without nagging about the first.
THE FLOOR IS REACT. `client.js` is 57 KB gzipped on its own and every route with an
island pays it, so the interesting number is not the total but the distance above ~60 KB.
A concept page is the heaviest at 72 KB because it mounts the most islands: depth toggle,
viz, mini-map, trail ribbon, trail count, search, and review actions.
`/` IS BUDGETED AT ZERO, AND THAT IS THE POINT. The landing page ships no JavaScript at
all. It is the page a stranger meets first and the clearest evidence for static-first, so
any island there should have to argue for itself in a pull request rather than arrive.
HTML IS RECORDED, NOT ENFORCED. It grows with the graph — /concepts lists every node —
and failing a build for publishing content would be the budget fighting the product.
TWO FIELDS, TWO JOBS (#286). `html_gzip` is an opt-in LIMIT, null everywhere, so nothing
is enforced; setting it to a number opts that route in, and `--update` refuses to turn a
note into a limit on its own. `html_gzip_measured` is the RECORD, written on every
`--update` and compared by nobody, so a jump shows up in a diff. This file used to say
the numbers were here so a jump would be visible while every one of them was null —
measured each run, printed to the console, and stored nowhere.
/concepts IS THE ONE THAT MOVES: 33.6 KB gzipped at 417 concepts, against 6.7 KB for the
heaviest concept page and 2.1 KB for the landing page. It lists every node, so it grows
about 80 B gzipped per concept.
RAISING A BUDGET IS A DECISION. `npm run perf -- --update` rewrites these, and the commit
message has to say what the extra weight bought.

/.note: No islands. Zero is the budget; adding one is a decision.

/concepts.note: Search overlay and trail count only. HTML grows with the graph.

/search.note: The panel itself. The index is fetched on open, not bundled.

/404.note: Nearest concepts plus the request form.

/c/*.note: The heaviest route, and the worst concept page is the one measured. Depth toggle, viz primitive, mini-map, trail ribbon, trail count, search, review actions.

/t/*.note: The whole page is one island (ADR-0008).
